secondary_routes.scope: Current atlas draws primary lanes only; this gate does not claim all painted rotation/circuit links appear on the atlas.

scope: Actual current native world/PhysicsSpace, configured hero predictive capsule sweeps, real ray hits, paving uniforms, atlas projection and live overview camera switch. Three short primary-route samples, one blocker, two decks, one sky ring and one visual apron point only. Two collision/map counterexamples and four marker/facing counterexamples are restored. Overview mapping expectations use captured manifest bounds and actual visual +Z facing; exact parent, pixels, plot, heading, player-camera origin/parent/owner restoration and approximate camera basis are required. Synchronous 10km position translations verify heading invariance plus zero/nonfinite handling. XZ map footprints do not encode elevation, ramps, navmesh connectivity, all-terrain clearance, army elevation, browser/online authority or rendered art acceptance.
